name.description: Set by Forgeline: the workflow's name, unique in the account.

functions.description: Set by Forgeline from the links: the functions it runs, in order.

locals.states: ${{for i, f in var.functions : f.id => merge({Type = "Task", Resource = "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", Parameters = {FunctionName = f.arn, "Payload.$" = "$"}, OutputPath = "$.Payload", TimeoutSeconds = var.timeout_seconds, Retry = [{ErrorEquals = ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException", "States.Timeout"], IntervalSeconds = 2, MaxAttempts = var.retries, BackoffRate = 2}]}, {for k in ["End"] : k => true if i == length(var.functions) - 1}, {for k in ["Next"] : k => try(var.functions[i + 1].id, "") if i < length(var.functions) - 1})}}
locals.definition: ${jsonencode({Comment = "Made by Forgeline", StartAt = try(var.functions[0].id, ""), States = local.states})}

wf.name: step-functions-workflow
wf.policy: ${jsonencode({Version = "2012-10-17", Statement = [{Sid = "InvokeLinkedFunctions", Effect = "Allow", Action = ["lambda:InvokeFunction"], Resource = concat([for f in var.functions : f.arn], [for f in var.functions : format("%s:*", f.arn)])}]})}

state_machine_arn.description: The workflow's ARN; start it with StartExecution
